description: Watch a category: on a schedule, search YouTube for new videos about it and auto-clip the best moments into viral shorts (moments and hooks picked by the local Claude Code CLI if installed, else YouTube's most-replayed peaks, else a transcript heuristic). Anything it can't clip (and live streams, if enabled) goes to the inbox for you. Replaces a watch with the same id. Runs via the background scheduler (see watch_scheduler).

autoClip.description: Default true. false = only collect videos into the inbox

id.description: Short name; defaults to a slug of the query

includeLive.description: Also surface streams that are live right now

maxAgeHours.description: Only videos uploaded within this many hours (default 72)

query.description: The category, phrased like a YouTube search, e.g. "netflix stock analysis"

name: create_watch
